caseName: Committee for Industrial Organization, American Civil Liberties Union v. Davis
caseNameFull: In the Matter of the Petition of Committee for Industrial Organization, American Civil Liberties Union, for a Writ of Mandamus and/or Prohibition v. Hon. J. Warren Davis, Hon. Joseph Buffington, Hon. J. Whitaker Thompson, Hon. Albert Branson Maris, and Hon. John Biggs, Jr., United States Circuit Judges of the Third Judicial Circuit and Committee for Industrial Organization, American Civil Liberties Union v. Hague

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for a writ of mandamus and/or prohibition, for a rule to show cause why a writ of certiorari should not issue, and for interim stay, denied without prejudice to a petition for writ of certiorari in accordance with the Rules of this Court.
